entities.name: Chronic constriction injury of the infraorbital nerve

relationships.subject: Nociceptive heat stimulus
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings demonstrate that PBCGRP neurons respond robustly to noxious heat stimuli applied to the trigeminal region.

relationships.subject: Chronic constriction injury of the infraorbital nerve
relationships.evidence_quote: The magnitude of the responses was 3 times larger after CCI

relationships.subject: Complete Freund's adjuvant
relationships.evidence_quote: mouse models of both neuropathic pain (CCI) and inflammatory pain (CFA) are associated with hyperactivity of PBN neurons in awake mice

relationships.subject: Parabrachial nucleus neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant, positive correlation was seen in 14 out of 17 cells across all 7 animals tested

key_findings: PBN neuron spontaneous and evoked activity is higher in awake than anesthetized mice; PBN-CGRP neurons respond to noxious heat.
PBN responses remain amplified for at least 5 weeks after CCI and after CFA, correlate with pupil-linked arousal, and can be conditioned to innocuous tones.
